popis:
Once again the camp is for all male (and possibly female) bikers who want to push their limits on rocky trails full of drops and descents full of technical pitfalls. If you have bike park experience but you struggle when it comes to northshore, rocks or roots, we have the ideal opportunity for you to progress. We'll show you lines that might not even have occurred to you and fine-tune what you already know.

LOCATION:

The Říčany area and surroundings offer plenty of places to have fun on legal and tolerated trails. So we'll move between spots by bike or by car, as agreed with the riders.

Parking by the park: Google Maps link

Meeting point in front of Vlasta's house: Google Maps link

(please don't block the street or others' exit from the car park)

You can also get to Tehov by train, from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Male and female bikers aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (must be a sufficiently skilled rider). In terms of ability, it's suitable for experienced riders in bike parks / on Enduro tracks.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (Enduro / Trail, longer travel) or a longer-travel e-bike
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • Knee and back protectors
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Lunch between trails. Refreshments are of course limited by the travelling.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).

SATURDAY – 11 May 2024

09:00 – 09:30  Riders arrive, registration and equipment check with bike setup

09:30 – 10:00 Introduction of instructors, information about the coaching and transfer to the first location

10:00 – 13:00 Spot 1

13:00 – 14:30 Lunch break, bike chat, digestion and discussion about anything and everything

14:30 – 17:30 Spot 2

17:30 – 18:00 Camp review, tips and so on …

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. Availability is shown as text, with details on request. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
